segments.mature: Reviewers who mention their age (mid-50s to late 60s) describe using this serum as part of an anti-aging regimen, with most reporting firmer, brighter, or more defined skin, though a couple in this group saw no difference.

concerns.aging: Several reviewers report visible firming, jawline definition, brighter and more even skin, and a youthful glow after weeks to a few months of use; two reviewers, including one who explicitly maintains a skincare regime, report no noticeable difference at all.

reserve: The 11 reviews focus almost entirely on the aging concern and mature skin, with no mentions of skin type (oily, dry, sensitive, etc.) or of other concerns like redness, spots, or dehydration, so conclusions cannot be extended beyond anti-aging use.
